new.s: In which year did Swami Vivekananda found the Ramakrishna Mission?
new.x: Vivekananda founded the Ramakrishna Mission on 1 May 1897, soon after returning from the West, and named it after his guru. 1879 is a common wrong version of 1897; 1875 is the founding year of the Arya Samaj and the Theosophical Society; 1902 is the year Vivekananda died.
new.tq: RKM = 1 May 1897, not 1879; Belur Math HQ came in 1898.

o: Madame H.P. Blavatsky and Col. H.S. Olcott

new.x: The Theosophical Society was founded at New York in 1875 by the Russian Madame H.P. Blavatsky and the American Col. H.S. Olcott. Annie Besant joined only in 1889 and became President in 1907; Malaviya worked with her on the Central Hindu College; Jiddu Krishnamurti was her adopted son; Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj.
new.tq: Theosophy founders = Blavatsky (Russian) + Olcott (American), New York 1875.

new.s: Who, along with Madan Mohan Malaviya, is regarded as a founder of the Central Hindu College at Benaras?
new.x: Annie Besant founded the Central Hindu College at Benaras in 1898; with Madan Mohan Malaviya it became the nucleus of Banaras Hindu University (1916). Olcott co-founded the Theosophical Society, Sister Nivedita was Vivekananda's disciple, and Shraddhanand led the Gurukul party of the Arya Samaj.

new.tq: Krishnamurti = At the Feet of the Master; Blavatsky = Isis Unveiled, Secret Doctrine.
